title: Silent Tax
desc: Observe how cash loses value when inflation outpaces bank APY.
to-teach: Invest to beat the inflation rate.
hints: With a 4% inflation rate, leaving all funds in 0% checking diminishes purchasing power over time.
Open a brokerage account yielding 8% APY and transfer idle reserves to outpace inflation.

client.name: Sarah
client.description: Sarah keeps $10,000 sitting in checking, unaware that annual inflation is silently eroding her purchasing power.
client.prompt: My savings aren't growing at all in checking, and rising prices make it feel like I have less money. How do I beat inflation?
